answer: Require every identity to pass an in-person music conservatory audition, performing live before a panel, where a juniper instrument on a terrace stage and an ivory piano cannot be played by an absent fake. Each fake identity costs at least 120 dollars for the audition plus travel and instrument hire, so 10 fakes cost at least 1,200 dollars and 100 fakes at least 12,000 dollars, and the cost rises further with more fakes because audition slots are scarce and panels notice repeated faces.
